facts.fact: The Citizen (2026-06-24) says the National Identification Authority will roll out Jamii Namba under the '2024-2034 Digital Economy Strategy', so its stated period had not ended; the article does not describe the strategy's scope (class left empty) or link its text. Text public: not stated

note: Class of the Digital Economy Strategy is empty because the article names it only as the framework under which Nida will roll out Jamii Namba. The cash-lite payments mandate is a 2026/27 budget measure, not a strategy.
